mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: ISM falls below 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period, it signals a deteriorating labor market that will weigh on consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month UNRATE change > 0.5pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the 10-year Treasury yield rises by more than 50 basis points over a 3-month period, it signals a tightening of financial conditions that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month DGS10 change > 50bp but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in retail sales turns negative, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by a rising unemployment rate.
failure_condition: RSAFS y-o-y change turns negative and UNRATE is rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index falls below 50 and the 10-year Treasury yield rises by more than 50 basis points over a 3-month period, it signals a toxic combination of slowing economic activity and tightening financial conditions that will drive sharply negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: ISM < 50 and DGS10 3-month change > 50bp, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period and the ISM manufacturing index falls below 50, it signals a broad-based economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE 3-month change > 0.5pp and ISM < 50, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises by more than 50 basis points over a 3-month period and the 10-year Treasury yield also rises by more than 50 basis points over the same period, it signals a aggressive tightening of monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: 3-month change in FEDFUNDS > 50bp and 3-month change in DGS10 > 50bp
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and DGS10 both rise by > 50bp over 3 months, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
